stem: The data of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, runs to September 2026. 60 businesses first paid in May 2026, and 48 of them paid in August, their month 3. 50 first paid in June 2026, and 41 of them paid in September, their month 3. 40 first paid in July 2026; their month 3 is October. Add up the paying businesses and the cohort sizes of the cohorts that have reached month 3. What is their month 3 retention? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
